semantics: Overflow aborts the fetch and releases its reader, timeout and cancellation observer.
No partial body reaches JSON parsing. Exact-limit bodies retain UTF-8/BOM/replacement behavior.
Gzip, deflate and Brotli expansion counts toward the limit regardless of compressed Content-Length.
Negotiation overflow submits no Unity command. Overflow after submission reports unknown outcome and retains known ticket/request/session identifiers.
No overflow response is retried, including protected acknowledgements and HTTP 500 bodies.
Discovery rejects oversized identities. Resource reads fail explicitly. Automatic context can be injected on a later call after an oversized read.
limitations: The initial baseline contains 19 tests (15 failures, four controls); three additional recovery/error tests were added after correction.
Per-response bound; fetch buffering, decompression, strings, JSON allocation and simultaneous responses can consume additional process memory.
The default does not bound incoming requests, original Unity objects, arbitrary getters or command execution.
Actual Unity validation uses 6000.6.2f1 on Windows. Older-editor runtime tests remain deferred by maintainer direction.
This checkpoint tests the current server against current/released plugins; it does not rerun every server-plugin pairing or every tool.
